summary: Clearwater National Forest tower in Idaho County, Idaho: L-4 cab on a 30-foot pole, built 1934, destroyed 1973. No source we read describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1973 according to three sources; no source we read describes what remains at the site.

staffing.status: no documented staffing history on Idaho Fire Lookouts

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in.

events.note: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the Forest Service list gives a 30-foot pole L-4 tower built 1934
Destroyed 1973 in all three sources; none of them gives a cause

evidence.supports: location about 12 miles east-southeast of Powell Ranger Station
built 1934 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1973
agency is the Clearwater National Forest
1934 L-4 cab on a 30-foot pole tower

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

corrections.why: firelookout.com gives Idaho County, Idaho; the record has only the state name

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 build and the 1973 destruction. The record's county 'Idaho' is the state name; proposed correction is Idaho County. The Forest Service list's row gives a 30-foot pole, 1934, 'Destroyed 1973.' and elevation 7405', so it now backs the story's elevation (evidence added). Its section and township are marked with a question mark, so they are not used. No source read describes the site today or says whether it is open to the public; the search turned up no further Dan Ridge page.
